articles.title: Macron addresses Ukraine, Greenland at NATO summit
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron told reporters at the NATO summit that he does not believe the US would seize Greenland and addressed issues concerning Ukraine and Iran.

articles.title: Replay: French President Emmanuel Macron speaks after Damascus blasts
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron held a press conference with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa during his landmark visit to Damascus after two bombs exploded near his hotel.

articles.title: Macron in Syria on first post-Assad visit by West European head of state
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron arrived in Damascus on Monday for the first visit by a Western European head of state since Syria's new authorities took power, accompanied by French business leaders.

articles.title: Macron lands in Syria in first post-Assad visit by Western head of state
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron landed in Syria on Monday alongside a delegation including representatives of French companies, marking the first visit by a Western head of state since the 2024 ousting of Bashar al-Assad.

articles.title: Macron's 'Versailles diplomacy' yields mixed results after a decade in power
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron hosted a G7 summit at Versailles where he courted US President Donald Trump, but analysts note he faces challenges translating diplomatic gestures into lasting strategic influence.
